title: 96-2009-04-elite
label: Michael Ahriman

won.source: Its eXpose of 27 April 2009 (posted that day): 'Exhausted, Ahriman raises his arm in victory ... and his handed the Elite Championship'; 'Winner: Michael Ahriman (Elite Champion)'.

how: Won the Elite Championship three-way from Jinx and Alex Kent.
note: The 6 May page calls him 'Elite Champion Michael Ahriman' and has Jinx win a shot at him for the pay-per-view; Jinx is 'the current Elite Champion' by Screaming For Vengeance, so the belt changed hands between those pages, in a show that was not recovered.

title: 96-2009-04-elite
label: Requiem

won.source: Its Screaming For Vengeance: 'Here is your winner and NEW Elite Champion, Requiem! ... awarded the brand new Elite Championship belt'.

how: Won at Screaming For Vengeance from Jinx.
note: Parental Advisory 11 (14 June 2009) closes with him 'holding up the Championship'.

won.source: Its Screaming For Vengeance: the ring announcer introduces 'the current Elite Champion, JINX'; when and from whom he won it is not given.

title: 96-2009-04-commonwealth
label: Salim Raj

won.source: Its eXpose of 27 April 2009: 'Commonwealth Championship: Chad Vargas vs. Makayla Fox vs. Salim Raj ... Winner: Salim Raj (Commonwealth Champion)'.

how: Won a three-way from Chad Vargas and Makayla Fox.

title: 96-2009-04-commonwealth
label: Makayla Fox

won.source: Its eXpose of 17 May 2009: the match is made a Commonwealth title match, and Fox wins it, 'crowning her the new Commonwealth champion'.

how: Won on the 17 May eXpose from Salim Raj, who had a leg under the bottom rope.
note: Defended against Brandon Maddox at Screaming For Vengeance ('STILL WU Commonwealth Champion') and against Twilight Rayn at Parental Advisory 11 ('granting her the title defense').

title: 96-2009-04-lugar
label: Chad Vargas

won.source: Its eXpose of 6 May 2009: 'Lugar Championship: Vargas vs. Fox', and the ring announcer's 'THE NEW LUGAR CHAMPION…CHAD VARGAS'.

how: Won the 6 May match, billed Vargas against Makayla Fox.
note: The page calls him the new champion but names no earlier holder.

title: 96-2009-04-lugar
label: Drake Daniels

won.source: Its Screaming For Vengeance: 'The winner of this match and NEW LUGAR CHAMPION, DRAKE DANIELS!!!'.

how: Won at Screaming For Vengeance from Chad Vargas.
note: The same night's commentary says the Lugar championship 'is going to become the One Shot'; Parental Advisory 11 calls him 'the newly crowned One Shot Champion'.

title: 96-2009-04-lugar
label: Skit-Zo

won.source: Its Parental Advisory 11: 'Here is your winner and the new One Shot Champion...SKIT-ZO'.

how: Won the One Shot Championship, the renamed Lugar belt, from Drake Daniels.

title: 96-2009-10-revolution-world
label: Johnny Styles

won.source: Its Revolution pay-per-view: 'the winner of this match and NEW 96 REVOULTION WORLD CHAMPION: JOHNNY STYLES!' (the Chaotic Cage's rules: 'The winner of the match will be named the 96 Undisputed World Champion').

how: Won the six-man Chaotic Cage match, the last man standing.
note: Beaten by Nathan Lancaster in the 3 November main event, which the owner's rival then declared a title change.

title: 96-2009-10-revolution-world
label: Nathan Lancaster

won.source: Its eXpose II of November 2009: Nathan Lancaster pins Johnny Styles, who wears the Revolution Championship, and Jason Burrows says 'your the new champion'.

how: Pinned the champion in the main event; Burrows declared it a title change and the owner replied that he was not.
note: The 9 November page calls him 'the Revoultion champion' and ends with Osh Vaughan taking the belt from the timekeeper's table; no change is recorded.

title: 96-2009-10-prodigy
label: Nathan Lancaster

won.source: Its Revolution pay-per-view: 'The man to get pinned, or submitted, will be rewarded the Prodigy Champion'; Johnny Styles pins Nathan Lancaster in the final fall. Its eXpose 1 bills 'Prodigy Championship: Nathan Lancaster vs. Rico Sutton'.

how: Awarded under the cage match rules to the last man pinned.
note: Defended against Rico Sutton on 26 October 2009; on 9 November Lobo carries off 'Nathan's prodigy championship' as a weapon.
